dialogs.about: 자고 간 손녀와 아침상을 차리며 이야기

lines.en: Good morning. Are you hungry now?
Yes, Grandma. I want pancakes, please.
I made porridge this morning. Try it first.
lines.ko: 오늘 아침에 죽을 만들었어요. 먼저 드셔 봐요.

lines.en: It smells sweet. Is there honey in it?
lines.ko: 달콤한 냄새가 나요. 안에 꿀이 들었어요?

lines.en: Yes, honey and warm milk are in it.
It tastes good. Can I have yogurt too?
Of course. The yogurt and cereal are here.
Thank you, Grandma. What about my pancakes?
I will scramble eggs and make pancakes tomorrow.
lines.ko: 내일은 달걀을 휘저어 익히고 팬케이크를 만들게요.

lines.en: Wow, thank you. I will wait until tomorrow.

dialogs.about: 동네 가게에서 아침거리를 고르며 점원과 이야기

lines.en: Good morning. May I help you today?
Yes, please. Do you have fresh yogurt?
We do. It arrived this morning.
Good. I will take two cups of yogurt.
We also have oatmeal and cereal here.
Is the oatmeal box expensive?
No, it is cheap. Please take a look.
Fine. I will take one box, thanks.
Do you need sausage or bacon today?
No, thank you. I bought bacon last week.
